Struct AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Configuration container for the AdaptiveFpsLimiter. Immutable (readonly) struct that holds all tunable parameters used to initialize and update the limiter.

public readonly struct AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings

Remarks

Several static presets are provided (Disabled, Default, NoAdditionalCooldown, Simple, Advanced). Instances are intended to be created via those presets or via the internal/private constructors exposed by the type; fields are public and readonly to allow cheap value-type copying.

Constructors

Settings()

Initializes a default AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings instance. Produces a disabled configuration with commonly used defaults: Enabled = false, RaiseFpsCooldownDuration = 2.0, RequiredConsecutiveChecks = 6, FasterFrameTimeAverageWeight = 0.5f, FramerateReduction = 5, CriticalFramerateReduction = 30, RequiredConsecutiveExtraCooldownChecks = 2, RaiseFpsAdditionalCooldownDuration = 1f, Tolerance = 1.25 ms (converted to seconds).

public Settings()

Remarks

Constructs a default AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings instance with the limiter disabled (Equivalent to Enabled = false). Use this preset when you want an explicit "limiter off" configuration.

Enabled

Whether the adaptive limiter is enabled. When false the limiter is inactive and will not adjust FPS.

NoAdditionalCooldown

Preset that enables the limiter but disables the additional raise-FPS cooldown. Sets RaiseFpsAdditionalCooldownDuration to 0 so repeated slowdowns do not increase the cooldown applied before raising FPS again.

Tolerance

Frame time tolerance in seconds. Small fluctuations within this tolerance are ignored to reduce oscillation. This value is specified in milliseconds in the constructor and static factory methods and internally converted to seconds. (tolerance in milliseconds / 1000.0 = Tolerance)

Methods

Advanced(double, int, float, int, int, int, float, float)

Creates an advanced preset AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings with fully configurable parameters for cooldowns, averaging, reduction steps and tolerances. This overload exposes every tunable value for fine-grained control of the adaptive FPS limiter's behavior.

public static AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings Advanced(double raiseFpsCooldownDuration = 2, int requiredConsecutiveChecks = 6, float fasterFrameTimeAverageWeight = 0.5, int framerateReduction = 5, int criticalFramerateReduction = 30, int requiredConsecutiveExtraCooldownChecks = 2, float additionalCooldown = 1, float millisecondTolerance = 1.25)

Parameters

raiseFpsCooldownDuration double

Base raise-FPS cooldown duration in seconds (default 2.0).

requiredConsecutiveChecks int

Number of consecutive faster/slower checks required to trigger an adjustment (default 6).

fasterFrameTimeAverageWeight float

Weight used when averaging recent faster frame times (range 0.0..1.0). 0.0 = use only running average; 1.0 = use only most recent frame time (default 0.5f).

framerateReduction int

FPS reduction applied on a normal slowdown (default 5).

criticalFramerateReduction int

FPS reduction applied on a critical slowdown (default 30).

requiredConsecutiveExtraCooldownChecks int

Number of consecutive slow-down adjustments required to add extra raise-FPS cooldown (default 2).

additionalCooldown float

Additional cooldown duration in seconds added per consecutive slowdowns (default 1f).

millisecondTolerance float

Frame time tolerance in milliseconds (default 1.25f). This is converted to seconds internally.

Returns

AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings

A new AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings instance configured with the provided advanced values.

Simple(int, int)

Creates a simple preset AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings with common, balanced defaults. Enables the adaptive limiter and sets the minimum/maximum FPS and reduction steps used when the limiter detects normal or critical slowdowns.

public static AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings Simple(int framerateReduction = 5, int criticalFramerateReduction = 30)

Parameters

framerateReduction int

FPS reduction applied on a normal slowdown. Default is 5.

criticalFramerateReduction int

FPS reduction applied on a critical slowdown. Default is 30.

Returns

AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings

A new AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings instance configured with the provided values.
